text:
sarah: Nightly perf CI flagged a regression for redwood-large-v1-8k at commit abc1234. p50 up ~18% vs baseline. Artifact: https://ci/internal/reports/1766334800. Can someone pick this up? I'm in back-to-back demos today.
perf-bot: PERF ALERT: nightly/benchmark/generation redwood-large-v1-8k exceeded threshold. baseline p50=45ms -> current p50=53ms. Artifact uploaded.
aj: @sarah grabbing this — will run the profiling harness now. Which dataset should I start with? I'll kick off long-seq first.
mike: I'll check scheduler/runner logs in case of infra drift, @aj — pulling the nightly pool logs now.
aj: Repro command I'm using:
```
./tools/bench/run.sh --model redwood-large-v1-8k --seq 1024 --runs 100 --save-profile out/abc1234.prof
```
lina: heads up — I landed a change to KV cache compaction (PR #2789) yesterday that touched eviction timing. Could be related.
deb: @lina good catch. That change was supposed to be behind a feature flag; I missed the rollout gating. Starting a revert now, will post PR.
aj: Quick profiler summary: attention memcpy time increased (14.8ms -> 22.4ms) and extra dtype-conversion memcpy showing up in trace.
mike: infra logs show one runner in the pool had a CUDA driver bump (12.2 -> 12.4) in the run window, looks like a partial upgrade rolled through.
sarah: :thumbsup: good leads. @deb please push the revert and tag this thread. @aj @mike coordinate to isolate infra vs runtime. If revert isn't fast, consider rolling a canary back to the previous build.
deb: Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2791 — CI green, awaiting manual approval for deploy.
perf-bot: ACTION: regression annotated. tags=[infra-driver, runtime-kv-cache]. candidate_commits=[abc1234]. candidate_prs=[2789,2791].
infra-bot: Noted. Pausing automated driver upgrades on nightly runners until triage completes.
lina: sorry team — my bad. I'll write a short postmortem note and follow up in #postmortems after we stabilize.
sarah: Thanks all. If nobody claims it by EOD I'll take it after my demo. :eyes:
